issues.explanation: Docs leave a stale TODO claiming single-call and concurrent-call protection still need tests even though the row-lock plus re-check is implemented.
Public invokable method has no PHPDoc block required by the docs-in-sync convention for touched public methods.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:33 domain write via app/Actions; docs/architecture.md:178-207, docs/business-rules.md:229 and CHANGELOG.md:9 keep docs in sync; nit: app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:35 public __invoke has no PHPDoc

readability.evidence: Clear names orderedCandidateIds/priorityStreakReached and small methods in app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:96-136; nit: stale TODO at docs/architecture.md:209-210

requirements.evidence: app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:40-47 queue lock plus fresh is_active; :51-57 fairness plus normal-exists check; :96-111 last-3 priority streak; :116-135 mode filters and priority DESC, issued_at ASC, id ASC ordering; :64-86 candidate lock plus waiting re-check, save of status/called_at/called_by_user_id and NoWaitingTicketsException; app/Enums/CallMode.php:8-12 and app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:6 contract

scope.evidence: change.diff only adds CallMode, NoWaitingTicketsException, CallNextTicket, tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php, plus required docs/business-rules.md, docs/architecture.md and CHANGELOG.md entries

security.evidence: No authorization required per task (caller trusted); app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:78-81 uses direct assignment plus save with no mass-assignment, no Livewire/Blade output, and inactive-queue path at :45-47 changes nothing

simplicity.evidence: app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:96-136 two focused helpers reusing TicketStatus, InactiveQueueException and IssueTicket; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:285-499 covers ordering, tie-breaks, queue scoping, all three modes, fairness trigger/reset/history/empty-normal/fewer-than-3, inactive plus stale queue, and called-marker return contract

review.summary: Implements CallNextTicket with the CallMode contract, deterministic ordering, 3-ticket fairness, queue plus candidate locking, and thorough tests and docs. Approve with nits for a stale architecture TODO and a missing PHPDoc on the public action method.
